# Inside a with or a range dot is the selected value, so .Redirect there names
# a field of that value and the route gets no redirect block. $.Redirect is the
# TemplateData wherever it is written, so it does.

muxt generate
! grep 'redirectURL != ""' template_routes.go

cp root.gohtml template.gohtml
muxt generate
grep 'redirectURL != ""' template_routes.go

-- in.go --
package main

func main() {}
-- template.go --
package main

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed template.gohtml
var templatesDir embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesDir, "template.gohtml"))
-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.25
-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / 200"}}{{with .Result}}{{.Redirect}}{{end}}{{range .Result.Items}}{{.Redirect}}{{end}}{{end}}
-- root.gohtml --
{{define "GET / 200"}}{{range .Result.Items}}{{$.Redirect "/x"}}{{end}}{{end}}
